unreported_quarters.2011Q1: Ownership change Genzyme to Sanofi; no full-quarter figure is published. Sanofi acquired Genzyme in April 2011; no Genzyme 2011Q1 10-Q or earnings 8-K exists on EDGAR. Sanofi's own EUR line begins 2011Q2 (sanofi_fabrazyme). Sanofi consolidates Genzyme from April 2011; its Q2 2011 release is the first to print a Fabrazyme line (EUR 30 million, 'Net sales since April 1st 2011' table). Genzyme-era quarters 2002Q3-2010Q4 (USD, Genzyme's own filings) are delivered under sanofi_fabrazyme_alt; Genzyme published no 2011Q1 financials (acquired April 2011), so the two cannot be joined contiguously and are in different currencies. Launch quarter not established: Genzyme's 10-K states Fabrazyme was marketed in Europe since 2001 and the US approval was April 2003.
